artifactText: {"schemaVersion":1,"findings":[{"id":"sql-injection-invoice-customer","title":"SQL injection through customer query parameter","severity":"critical","location":"Lines 8-10, especially `customer = '${req.query.customer}'`","evidence":"The route interpolates untrusted `req.query.customer` directly into the SQL string passed to `db.query(sql)`. Quote characters and SQL syntax in the parameter can alter the query structure.","repair":"Use the database driver's parameterized-query API, for example `db.query('SELECT id, total FROM invoices WHERE customer = $1', [customer])`, after validating `customer` is a string with an expected length and format.","confidence":"high"},{"id":"path-traversal-download-name","title":"Path traversal in download file selection","severity":"high","location":"Lines 14-16, `path.join(DATA_ROOT, req.query.name)` followed by `res.sendFile(requested)`","evidence":"The user-controlled `req.query.name` is joined into a server filesystem path with no containment check. Traversal segments can cause the resulting path to resolve outside `/srv/app/downloads`.","repair":"Require `name` to be a validated relative filename or opaque file identifier. Resolve it with `path.resolve(DATA_ROOT, name)` and reject it unless it begins with `DATA_ROOT + path.sep`; reject absolute paths before calling `res.sendFile`.","confidence":"high"},{"id":"command-injection-diagnostics-host","title":"Shell command injection through diagnostics host","severity":"critical","location":"Lines 19-20, `exec(`ping -c 1 ${req.body.host}`)`","evidence":"The route inserts untrusted `req.body.host` into a command string given to `exec`, which invokes a shell. Shell metacharacters in the host value can execute additional commands.","repair":"Avoid shell command construction. Use `execFile('ping', ['-c', '1', validatedHost], callback)` or equivalent argument-array execution, and strictly validate `validatedHost` as an IP address or approved hostname.","confidence":"high"}],"summary":"The source contains three source-grounded high-impact injection issues: SQL injection in invoice lookup, path traversal in download handling, and shell command injection in diagnostics."}
